$comment: The ONLY file that names a model. Tiers are roles; models are interchangeable. `model` is what agents/ pin and what the route guard expects; `match` are substrings that identify a session model as belonging to this tier (word-bounded, case-insensitive); `fallbacks` is the order to try when the tier's model is unavailable or its limit is spent. Override per machine at ~/.claude/orchestrator/tiers.json (same shape, any subset of keys). `max_effort` caps the reasoning effort any spawn on that tier may use.

chair.role: Plans, briefs, decides, arbitrates, accepts. Never does volume.

heavy.role: Predictably hard slices: architecture, irreversible migrations, stubborn debugging, ALL security review, fresh-eyes verification.

bulk.role: The volume: implementation to spec, tests, refactors, briefs, standard review, research synthesis.

cheap.role: Mechanical lookups: grep, scan, fetch-to-disk, format checks, report-shape validation.
